name: cluster
description: Cluster-pays mechanic: orthogonally-adjacent same-symbol groups (wilds connect) of at least the minimum size pay from the Paytable by cluster size. This is a SANCTIONED C# FAST-PATH (invariant 11 / D25), not a hardcoded molecule (invariant 2): cluster detection is a BFS flood-fill over the 2D board, which needs nested/unbounded iteration that level-(b) expressions forbid (no nested folds, G9), so it cannot be authored as a pure subgraph. The ClusterEvaluator fast-path is proven equivalent to an independent BFS flood-fill oracle over 10,000+ PBT cases with auto-shrinking (FastPathEquivalenceTests). The 'board' port carries the flat state array (invariant 4 — there is no kernel Board type) to the per-game registered evaluator. Input port: 'board'. Output port: 'wins'.
